eight_body_contracts.analytical_job: State measurement, stability, availability and independence assumptions
eight_body_contracts.handoff: Concept analysis proceeds under those limits

eight_body_contracts.rhetorical_job: Turn a broad ideal into a tractable exposition
eight_body_contracts.analytical_job: Use an example, admit identification difficulty, identify factor families and qualify their partition
eight_body_contracts.output: Named explanatory dimensions and factor roles
eight_body_contracts.handoff: Environmental/resource factors are handed to3.2; construction continues in3.3

eight_body_contracts.rhetorical_job: Explain why the starting approach is retained but extended
eight_body_contracts.analytical_job: State several author-perceived limitations; no formula-level critique is verified
eight_body_contracts.output: Motivation for a broader representation and altered construction

eight_body_contracts.input: Proposed dimensions, candidate indices and data
eight_body_contracts.rhetorical_job: Move from construction to an illustrative use
eight_body_contracts.analytical_job: Announce screened indices, combined operations, intended measurement and data treatments; formal stages remain deferred
eight_body_contracts.output: Author-reported case verdicts and differentiated explanations
eight_body_contracts.handoff: Selected-case and forecast roles move to3.3.4 and4

eight_body_contracts.input: A proposed measure and illustrative case outputs
eight_body_contracts.rhetorical_job: Map forecasting and policy tasks to their next analytical route
eight_body_contracts.analytical_job: Separate reference/intervention tasks, reinterpret a policy as intervention, state comparison claims
eight_body_contracts.output: Forward interfaces to4.1 and5 plus unverified method-property contrasts
eight_body_contracts.handoff: 4 develops the case proposal;5 develops intervention analysis

eight_body_contracts.input: Selected case, reference forecast and rough influence directions
eight_body_contracts.rhetorical_job: Make a proposed plan inspectable rather than list disconnected actions
eight_body_contracts.analytical_job: Separate effect and feasibility screens, contextualize rough directions, specify recipients and operational targets
eight_body_contracts.handoff: 5 uses expected achievements as simulation inputs, not observed effects

eight_body_contracts.input: Proposed settings and stated interacting subsystems
eight_body_contracts.rhetorical_job: Connect an extension and comparison exercise to a decision
eight_body_contracts.analytical_job: Announce dynamic relationships, estimation repair, reference consistency, comparison frame and reported multi-criterion interpretation
eight_body_contracts.output: Author-reported preferred programme under the stated exercise
eight_body_contracts.handoff: 6 returns to scope, claimed strengths and unresolved data/representation limits

eight_body_contracts.input: Construction, intended uses and implementation experience reported by authors
eight_body_contracts.analytical_job: Relate claimed scope/presentation advantages to prior work and retain excluded shocks, missing inputs and representation restrictions
eight_body_contracts.output: Bounded text account of claimed capability and limitations
eight_body_contracts.handoff: References provide attribution, not additional author-style evidence

positive_full_text_route: assumptions -> ideal/example and measurable factors -> baseline limitations -> proposed construction and case illustration -> reference/intervention task map -> case forecast -> effect and feasibility screens -> operational programmes -> dynamic extension and stated data repair -> announced reference check -> option comparisons -> joint-measure recommendation -> scope and data limits
claim_boundaries: No broad algorithm-family criticism or source superiority claim is adopted as established technical fact.
The expected no-intervention agreement is an author claim; no plot equality or equation identity is verified.
Proposed programme rates are scenario inputs, not calibrated effects or observed achievements.
The final choice has a prose support path, but plots/tables and the claimed winning effect remain unaccepted.
The data-remedy assurance in the limitations section is not treated as actual data recovery.
remaining: second and further prose scans until the final bounded scan adds zero moves
subsection-level five-part contracts and paragraph/argument handoffs
mixed prose/notation boundaries remain deferred with paused work
